title: Integrate PR 513 with the Kubernetes demo suite
description: Validate PR 513 from an isolated integration branch against the committed Docker Desktop Kubernetes demo. Preserve the initial unmodified failure, implement only the specified local GraphQL ticket, verified TLS, explicit authentication, and resume-path compatibility, then prove two fresh strict runs plus retained verification. Use public data only and record sanitized evidence.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Outside-in compatibility results: the unchanged PR branch first failed during run-scoped dataset curation because the lean worker extra omitted direct CLI import dependencies. Added an executable dependency contract and the minimal declared runtime set. Implemented local GraphQL artifact transfer tickets with resource/account/key/size/checksum validation, HTTPS-only signed URLs, explicit API-key auth, reusable MinIO TLS/CA wiring, integrity-bearing task output envelopes, GraphQL-ticket resume, and a one-shot post-optimizer interruption hook. Focused evidence is green: 73 product/demo/chart tests and 63 private-proxy tests. Live immutable-image deployment and strict runs remain pending.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Final rollout exposed a repeated procedure-recovery CronJob failure that the main deployment readiness assertions did not cover. A captured diagnostic Job failed before recovery logic because its Plexus client attempted Cognito: the CronJob omitted explicit PLEXUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH_MODE=api_key even though the main worker deployment had it. Every scheduled job reached BackoffLimitExceeded. Next: add a rendered-chart specification for explicit CronJob auth, wire the same Secret-backed settings into the recovery pod, redeploy, and require a successful diagnostic recovery Job.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Recovery CronJob specification first failed because PLEXUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH_MODE was absent. Added the same required explicit api_key value used by the worker deployment while retaining the existing shared Secret-backed PLEXUS_API_KEY. No authentication fallback was added. Rendered chart and demo harness checks are green: 19 passed; Ruff and diff checks pass. Next: deploy committed snapshot and require a terminally successful recovery Job plus no new BackoffLimitExceeded event.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: During rebase onto current PR 513 head, the upstream branch already introduced the canonical plexus.api.authMode model. The older local graphqlAuthMode field would have emitted a second PLEXUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH_MODE=api_key and overridden explicit IAM rendering. Removed that obsolete duplicate path, retained upstream API-key/CronJob wiring, and kept the regression assertion that recovery uses the same Secret-backed key.
